column7: RevertAccessReviewItemClaim had no campaign-is-open condition. The access-review revoke is now one transaction (claim, removal, rollback together; ar-revoke-atomic-001..004, #2676), so the compensating revert has no production caller and the gap it described is unreachable. The dead storage method itself is left in place (cleanup is a separate S item). Found by ISSUE-TRIAGE-1 (2026-10-17).
